title: Father's generation called UFOs at nuclear tests 'tagalongs'

tellings.quote: So dad said, "Yeah, we called it a tag along."

plain: In the 1950s and 60s, UFOs were seen often enough around American nuclear test sites that the men who worked there had a nickname for them: "tagalongs." The economist Pippa Malmgren tells this on the show from her own father, who said, "Yeah, we called it a tag along." If true, it would suggest that strange objects showing up at atomic tests were familiar to the people running them.
